about: The paged card's open and close (the update card; the grand opening uses the same code) on the dev app in Glass, the heaviest skin to draw. The open: the card comes up from below in the skin's page motion while the cards behind fade out. The close: it leaves upward while the cards rise back in their launch stagger. The skin is set for the shot and put back.
pass: Each probe's expect holds. In the strips: the open's first frame still shows the cards, the card rises from the bottom edge, and nothing jumps at its landing; the close's card leaves upward, and the cards come in one slot after the next. In the console file: the updatecard-open and updatecard-close frames lines.
run: node scripts/shots.mjs --list docs/ops/checks/paged-card-motion.json   (needs `npm run dev:app` running, its window on screen)
